results.stdout:
callback checks:
  a delivered callback carries the bearer token and the exact payload
  a network error and a 500 are retried; the third attempt lands
  a 401 stops immediately and says the tokens do not match
  a 413 stops immediately and points at the size ceiling
  an exhausted retry budget reports how many attempts were made
  encode_payload measures the bytes the POST would actually send
all callback checks passed

contract checks:
  enums, caps and the succeeded-requires-pages rule match the schema file
  no confidence/certainty/likelihood field in the schema or the worker
  the full and the minimal request both validate
  strictness: unknown keys, id length, checksum case, language codes, url scheme, refs
  page invariant: drops, gaps, duplicates, order, extra fields and caps all refused
  callback builder: status vocabulary, pages-required, pages-forbidden, invariant
all contract checks passed
durable acceptance, exact result retry, retained source, identity and cancellation checks passed

intake checks:
  a matching document is accepted, and the ceiling reaches the fetcher
  a checksum mismatch is refused
  a declared-size mismatch is refused
  a file that is not a PDF is refused before the recogniser sees it
  an empty download is refused
  a document over the ceiling is refused, naming the variable
  a non-http(s) source URL is refused
  a request with no declared checksum is still accepted
  the real fetcher takes a byte ceiling
all intake checks passed

ocr checks:
  the page split drops exactly one trailing separator, never a blank page
  three pages come back numbered 1, 2, 3 with their own text
  a page that recognised nothing keeps its number and ships empty
  a disagreement between the three page counts fails the job, naming all three
  a language with no trained data fails, naming it and what is installed
  a failed language probe does not masquerade as 'no languages installed'
  a document over the page ceiling is refused whole, never truncated
  recogniser failure, missing output, missing binary and timeout each name themselves
  ocrmypdf keeps existing text and the requested languages; pdftotext keeps the layout
all ocr checks passed

worker HTTP + pipeline checks:
[ocr-worker] 127.0.0.1 "POST /api/v1/ocr-requests HTTP/1.1" 401 -
[ocr-worker] 127.0.0.1 "POST /api/v1/ocr-requests HTTP/1.1" 401 -
  no bearer and a wrong bearer both get 401, and queue nothing
[ocr-worker] 127.0.0.1 "POST /api/v1/ocr-requests HTTP/1.1" 422 -
  a contract-invalid payload gets 422 with the violations listed
[ocr-worker] 127.0.0.1 "POST /api/v1/ocr-requests HTTP/1.1" 202 -
[ocr-worker] 127.0.0.1 "POST /api/v1/ocr-requests HTTP/1.1" 200 -
  a valid request is accepted once; the same requestId gets the same answer
[ocr-worker] 127.0.0.1 "GET /healthz HTTP/1.1" 200 -
  /healthz names the three programs the image needs and the language probe
[ocr-worker] 127.0.0.1 "POST /api/v1/nope HTTP/1.1" 404 -
  an unknown path is 404
[ocr-worker] 127.0.0.1 "POST /api/v1/ocr-requests HTTP/1.1" 503 -
  a full queue answers 503 with the reason, never a silent accept
[ocr-worker] 127.0.0.1 "POST /api/v1/ocr-requests HTTP/1.1" 503 -
  a worker with no token refuses every request instead of serving open
  the succeeded callback carries every page, blank ones included
  a payload over the consumer's ceiling fails with both numbers, never a 413 loop
  a page sequence the invariant rejects fails the job instead of shipping
all worker HTTP + pipeline checks passed
